textRuns.value: Ordinary least squares on log burnt area (EFFIS), country fixed effects, metrics standardised within each country, standard errors clustered by country, 95 % intervals; a Bayesian fit (95 % HDI) and the variants (year effects, linear trend, EU only, Mediterranean only, fires above 100 ha) back the robust flag. Multiplier: burnt area is multiplied by it for one standard deviation more of the metric. Weather share: within-country variance explained by the weather terms, in sample and out of sample against the country mean. Statistical association, not causation: weather governs how far a fire runs, people start nearly all of them.
